description: Find a Japan train station by name, in English or Japanese ("Shinjuku" or "新宿"), and return its ODPT station id(s), operator, railway and coordinates — for looking up Japanese railway/metro stations (Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other operators). ODPT has no name-search endpoint, so this fetches station master data for the given operator (or a short list of major Tokyo operators if none is given) and matches client-side — one station can have several ids, one per operator/railway that serves it. Use the returned station_id with odpt_station_timetable. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_resolve_station({ query: "Shinjuku" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

operator.description: Limit to one operator, e.g. "Tokyo Metro", "JR East", "Toei", or an exact odpt.Operator id. Default: searches several major Tokyo operators.

query.description: Station name in English or Japanese, e.g. "Shinjuku" or "新宿".

name: odpt_resolve_station
